title: OmniBrain-0：面向具身智能的统一智能体模型
summary: OmniBrain-0 是一个轻量级统一具身智能体，通过共享高层决策模型协调操作与导航，整合任务理解、规划、进度跟踪与失败恢复。采用渐进式训练框架，结合具身预训练、领域专家蒸馏与多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD），并提出评分引导的递归自我改进（RSI）数据飞轮，在多个基准和真实任务上以更低推理开销实现强跨域性能。
summary_en: OmniBrain-0 is a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation via a shared high-level decision model integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and failure recovery. It uses progressive training with embodied pretraining, domain-specialized distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD), plus Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI). It achieves strong cross-domain performance with much lower inference overhead than its closed-source teacher.
